title: ScalarCupZeroGlobalSections
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $F,G$ module sheaves on $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $d_f$ denote the canonical degree-zero global-section comparison [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison]. For all $a\in H_k^0(f,F)$ and $b\in H_k^0(f,G)$, the internal cup defined in [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations] satisfies $d_f(a\cup b)=d_f(a)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}d_f(b)$ as a global section of $F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}G$. No quasi-coherence or nonemptiness is required.

proof.text: Use the degree-zero Ext comparison to represent each input by its scalar section morphism. Expand scalarCohomologyCup and scalarExtCup. Exact-functor transport and Ext composition preserve mk₀; combine the two whiskerings into the tensor of the section morphisms. Apply the scalar tensor section-morphism identity, then use injectivity of the Ext comparison and the inverse law of the global-section equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCohomologyCup_zero_globalSections
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F G : X.Modules)
    (a : scalarCohomology f F 0) (b : scalarCohomology f G 0) :
    scalarGlobalSectionsEquiv f (F ⊗ G) (scalarCohomologyCup f F G 0 0 a b) =
      tmulSection (scalarGlobalSectionsEquiv f F a) (scalarGlobalSectionsEquiv f G b)
